description: This file contains the definition of the pBubble class, which is responsible for drawing bubble charts using the pChart library. It includes methods for scaling data, resetting colors, drawing bubble charts, and writing labels, along with some external constant definitions.

classes.name: pBubble
classes.description: Class to draw bubble charts with methods for scaling data, drawing, and labeling bubbles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the pChartObject and pDataObject dependencies.

methods.name: bubbleScale
methods.description: Prepares the scaling of data series and associated weights for bubble size representation.

methods.name: resetSeriesColors
methods.description: Resets the colors of data series to their default palette.

methods.name: drawBubbleChart
methods.description: Draws the bubble chart on the canvas based on data and formatting options.

methods.name: writeBubbleLabel
methods.description: Writes labels for each bubble with optional formatting.
